assessment: A-level tool-first page for "og image size" (880/mo, KD 15): the OG Image Checker is the first screen, the 50-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "og image checker", "open graph image checker", "og image test" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "og image size" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Meta recommends at least 1200x630, ~1.91:1, max 8 MB; 600x315 minimum for large cards; images cached by URL.
LinkedIn shared-link images: minimum 1200x627, ratio 1.91:1, max 5 MB.
Open Graph protocol: four required properties og:title, og:type, og:image, og:url; og:image:width/height.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.
